exercises.name: Seated partial stand
exercises.cue: Lean forward, nose over toes, and lift your hips just off the seat.

exercises.name: Sit to stand, high chair
exercises.cue: Hands on your thighs to help. Stand tall, then sit back slowly.

exercises.name: Sit to stand
exercises.cue: Arms crossed, feet flat. Stand up tall, then lower slowly to the seat.

exercises.name: Box squat
exercises.cue: Sit back until you just touch the box, then drive up through your heels.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.cue: Hold the weight at your chest, elbows down. Sit between your heels.

exercises.name: Slow goblet squat
exercises.cue: Three seconds down, a short pause, then stand.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: Press the plate away without locking your knees, then let it come back slowly.

exercises.name: Seated good morning
exercises.cue: Arms crossed, back long. Tip forward from your hips, then sit tall.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: Squeeze your bottom and lift your hips until you're in a line from knees to shoulders.

exercises.name: Broom hinge
exercises.cue: Keep the handle touching your head, back and bottom as you hinge forward.

exercises.name: Backpack Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Soft knees. Slide the bag down your thighs, hips back, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Hips back, weights close to your legs. Stop when you feel the backs of your thighs.

exercises.name: Kettlebell deadlift
exercises.cue: Bell between your feet. Push the floor away and stand up tall.

exercises.name: Hip thrust
exercises.cue: Upper back on the bench, chin tucked. Drive your hips up and squeeze.

exercises.name: Seated band chest press
exercises.cue: Band round the chair back. Press forward until your arms are long, then slowly return.

exercises.name: Wall press-up
exercises.cue: Hands on the wall at shoulder height. Bend your elbows and bring your chest towards it.

exercises.name: Counter press-up
exercises.cue: Hands on the edge, body in one line. Lower your chest to the counter.

exercises.name: Chair press-up
exercises.cue: Chair against a wall. Hands on the seat, lower with control.

exercises.name: Knee press-up
exercises.cue: Knees down, hips in line. Lower your chest between your hands.

exercises.name: Press-up
exercises.cue: Body like a plank. Lower until your chest is just above the floor.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.cue: Feet flat. Lower the weights to the sides of your chest, then press up.

exercises.name: Wall slide
exercises.cue: Forearms on the wall. Slide them up as high as is comfortable, then back down.

exercises.name: Seated bottle press
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Press the bottles overhead, then lower them to your shoulders.

exercises.name: Band overhead press
exercises.cue: Stand on the band. Press straight up, ribs down, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling dumbbell press
exercises.cue: One knee down, squeeze that side's bottom. Press up, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Standing dumbbell press
exercises.cue: Feet hip-width, ribs down. Press the weights overhead, then lower to your shoulders.

exercises.name: Machine shoulder press
exercises.cue: Back against the pad. Press the handles up, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Prone Y raise
exercises.cue: Lying face down, arms in a Y. Lift your arms a little, forehead stays low.

exercises.name: Seated band row
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Standing band row
exercises.cue: Soft knees, chest proud. Pull your elbows past your ribs.

exercises.name: Supported bottle row
exercises.cue: One hand on the counter, back long. Pull the bottle up towards your ribs, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
exercises.cue: Hand on the bench, back flat. Pull the weight to your hip.

exercises.name: Table row
exercises.cue: Under a sturdy table, heels down, body straight. Pull your chest to the edge.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.cue: Sit tall, knees soft. Pull the handle to your ribs, then let your arms go long.

exercises.name: Overhead band pull-apart
exercises.cue: Arms up, band taut. Pull it apart and down behind your head.

exercises.name: Seated band pull-down
exercises.cue: Band over the top of a door. Pull your elbows down to your sides.

exercises.name: Kneeling band pull-down
exercises.cue: Tall kneeling, bottom squeezed. Pull your elbows down and back.

exercises.name: Assisted pull-up
exercises.cue: Feet on the chair to take some weight. Pull your chest up towards the bar.

exercises.name: Lat pull-down
exercises.cue: Thighs under the pad. Pull the bar to your upper chest, then let it rise slowly.

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.cue: Hang long, then pull until your chin clears the bar. Lower all the way.

exercises.name: Seated knee extension
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Straighten one knee, pause, and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Supported split stance
exercises.cue: One foot forward, hand on the counter. Bend both knees a little and hold.

exercises.name: Supported split squat
exercises.cue: Lower your back knee towards the floor, then push back up.

exercises.name: Step-up
exercises.cue: Whole foot on the step. Push through it to stand up, then step down.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
exercises.cue: Step back and lower your back knee towards the floor. Push through your front foot to return.

exercises.name: Dumbbell split squat
exercises.cue: Weights by your sides. Drop your back knee straight down, then stand.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.cue: Back foot on the bench. Lower until your front thigh is nearly level.

exercises.name: Seated hold
exercises.cue: Sit tall with a bag in each hand. Shoulders back and down, breathe and hold.

exercises.name: Bottle walk
exercises.cue: A bottle in each hand. Walk tall, slow and steady.

exercises.name: Shopping bag carry
exercises.cue: A bag in each hand, shoulders down. Walk tall and keep the bags still.

exercises.name: Suitcase carry
exercises.cue: Weight in one hand. Don't let it pull you sideways.

exercises.name: Farmer's carry
exercises.cue: Heavy weights, tall posture, small steady steps.

exercises.name: Kettlebell carry
exercises.cue: Grip hard, shoulders down, walk slowly.

exercises.name: Front-rack carry
exercises.cue: Bells at your chest, elbows tucked. Breathe and walk.

exercises.name: Seated lean-back
exercises.cue: Arms crossed, sit tall. Lean back a little, hold, then come forward.

exercises.name: Heel slide
exercises.cue: Lower back gently pressed down. Slide one heel away, then back.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: Back flat. Reach one arm back and the opposite leg out, then swap.

exercises.name: Incline plank
exercises.cue: Hands on the counter, body in one line. Breathe and hold.

exercises.name: Knee plank
exercises.cue: Forearms down, knees down, hips in line with your shoulders. Hold.

exercises.name: Plank with reach
exercises.cue: Hold the plank and reach one arm forward without letting your hips rock.

exercises.name: Ab wheel rollout
exercises.cue: From your knees, roll out only as far as you can keep your back flat.

exercises.name: Seated band press-out
exercises.cue: Band anchored to one side. Press it out in front and don't let it turn you.

exercises.name: Seated march
exercises.cue: Sit tall, tummy braced. Lift one knee, lower, then the other.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.cue: On all fours. Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back, then swap.

exercises.name: Knee side plank
exercises.cue: On your side, knees bent. Lift your hips and hold.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.cue: Band anchored at your side, chest height. Press out and resist the turn.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.cue: Elbow under shoulder, feet stacked. Lift your hips into a straight line.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling chop
exercises.cue: Pull the band from high behind you down across your body, hips still.

exercises.name: Seated reach
exercises.cue: Sit tall, feet flat. Reach forward as far as feels steady, then sit back.

exercises.name: Feet together, with support
exercises.cue: Feet together, a hand near the counter. Stand tall and breathe.

exercises.name: Heel-to-toe stand, with support
exercises.cue: One foot directly in front of the other. Hold steady.

exercises.name: Single-leg stand, with support
exercises.cue: Lift one foot, a fingertip on the counter. Hold.

exercises.name: Heel-to-toe walk
exercises.cue: Heel touches toe with every step. Eyes ahead, arms out a little.

exercises.name: Single-leg reach
exercises.cue: Standing on one leg, tip forward and reach, back leg long. Return to tall.

exercises.name: Single-leg stand on a cushion
exercises.cue: One foot on the cushion, arms out a little. Hold steady.

exercises.name: Seated heel raise
exercises.cue: Feet flat. Lift your heels as high as you can, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Standing heel raise
exercises.cue: Fingertips on the counter. Rise onto the balls of your feet, then lower.

exercises.name: Slow heel raise on a step
exercises.cue: Balls of your feet on the edge. Lower your heels slowly below the step, then rise.

exercises.name: Single-leg heel raise, supported
exercises.cue: One foot hooked behind. Rise up, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Single-leg heel raise, 3-2-3
exercises.cue: Three seconds up, hold for two, three seconds down.

exercises.name: Weighted single-leg heel raise
exercises.cue: Weight in your free hand. Full range, slow on the way down.

exercises.name: Seated cushion squeeze
exercises.cue: A cushion between your knees. Squeeze it gently for a slow count of five, then relax.

exercises.name: Counter mini squat
exercises.cue: Hands resting on the counter. Bend your knees and sit back a little, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Wall slide squat
exercises.cue: Back against the wall, feet a step forward. Slide down a little way, then press back up.

exercises.name: Sit to stand holding a bag
exercises.cue: Hug the bag to your chest. Stand up tall, then lower slowly to the seat.

exercises.name: Backpack squat
exercises.cue: Hug the bag to your chest, elbows down. Sit between your heels, then stand.

exercises.name: Heel-raised squat
exercises.cue: Heels on a rolled towel, arms out in front. Sit straight down with your chest tall, then stand.

exercises.name: Heel-raised goblet squat
exercises.cue: Heels on a rolled towel, weight at your chest. Sit straight down, slow, then stand.

exercises.name: Barbell back squat
exercises.cue: Bar across your upper back, chest proud. Sit down between your heels, then drive up.

exercises.name: Seated shin slide
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Tip forward from your hips as your hands slide down your shins, then sit back up.

exercises.name: Counter hip hinge
exercises.cue: Hands on the counter. Push your hips back as your hands slide forward, back long, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Standing hip extension
exercises.cue: Hands on the counter, stand tall. Take one straight leg back, squeeze your bottom, then return.

exercises.name: Hip hinge to a wall
exercises.cue: Stand a foot from the wall, back to it. Push your bottom back to touch it, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Supported single-leg deadlift
exercises.cue: One hand on the counter. Tip forward as one leg reaches back long, then return to tall.

exercises.name: Backpack good morning
exercises.cue: Backpack on, arms crossed. Soft knees, hinge forward with a long back, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Staggered-stance bag deadlift
exercises.cue: Front foot flat, back toes down for balance. Hinge with the bags close to your front leg, then stand.

exercises.name: Single-leg deadlift with a bag
exercises.cue: The bag in both hands. Tip forward as one leg reaches back, hips level, then return to tall.

exercises.name: Kettlebell single-leg deadlift
exercises.cue: Bell in both hands. Tip forward as one leg reaches back long, then push the floor away to stand.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Soft knees, bar close to your legs. Push your hips back until you feel your hamstrings, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Seated wall press-up
exercises.cue: Sit facing the wall, hands flat on it. Bend your elbows to lean in, then push back to tall.

exercises.name: Seated palm press
exercises.cue: Palms together in front of your chest. Press them firmly together as you push forward, then draw back.

exercises.name: Wall press-up plus
exercises.cue: Arms straight, hands on the wall. Let your chest sink a little, then push the wall away so your shoulder blades spread.

exercises.name: Table press-up
exercises.cue: Hands on the edge of a sturdy table, body in one line. Lower your chest towards it, then press away.

exercises.name: One-arm wall press-up
exercises.cue: One hand on the wall, the other on your hip. Lower your chest towards the wall, then press away.

exercises.name: Step press-up
exercises.cue: Hands on a low step, body in one line from head to heels. Lower your chest to the step, then press away.

exercises.name: Lower-down press-up
exercises.cue: From a full press-up, lower slowly for three seconds. Knees down to press up, then step back out.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
exercises.cue: Back against the pad, handles at chest height. Press forward without locking your elbows, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Broom overhead press
exercises.cue: Hold a broom handle across the front of your shoulders. Press it straight up, ribs down, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Standing bottle press
exercises.cue: Stand tall, a bottle in each hand. Press them overhead, then lower to your shoulders.

exercises.name: Backpack overhead press
exercises.cue: Hold the bag by its sides at your chest. Press it overhead, ribs down, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Staggered-stance one-arm press
exercises.cue: One foot a little ahead, a bottle in one hand. Press it straight up, then lower to your shoulder.

exercises.name: Wall pike press
exercises.cue: Hands high on the wall, hips back so your body makes an L. Bend your elbows to bring your head towards the wall, then press away.

exercises.name: One-arm backpack press
exercises.cue: Hold the bag by its top handle at your shoulder. Press it overhead, ribs down, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Arnold press
exercises.cue: Start with the weights in front of your face, palms towards you. Turn them out as you press up, then reverse on the way down.

exercises.name: Barbell overhead press
exercises.cue: Bar at the front of your shoulders, ribs down. Press it straight up, head through at the top, then lower.

exercises.name: Back-to-wall elbow press
exercises.cue: Back to the wall, elbows bent at your sides. Press your elbows back into the wall, hold for five, then relax.

exercises.name: Seated towel row
exercises.cue: Towel round the soles of your feet, legs long. Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Bent-over bottle row
exercises.cue: Soft knees, hinge forward with a long back. Pull both bottles up towards your ribs, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Supported backpack row
exercises.cue: One hand on the counter, back long. Pull the bag up towards your hip, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Bent-over backpack row
exercises.cue: Hold the bag by its straps, back long. Pull it up to your tummy, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Bent-over bag row
exercises.cue: A loaded bag in each hand, hinge forward with a flat back. Pull the bags up to your ribs, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Chair-supported bag row
exercises.cue: One hand on a sturdy chair, back flat. Pull the bag up to your hip, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Table row, knees bent
exercises.cue: Under a sturdy table, knees bent and feet flat. Pull your chest up to the edge, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell bent-over row
exercises.cue: Hinge forward with a flat back, bar hanging. Pull it to your lower ribs, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Wall angel
exercises.cue: Back and head against the wall. Slide your arms up as high as is comfortable, then draw your elbows down to your sides.

exercises.name: Seated towel pull-down
exercises.cue: Hold a towel overhead, hands wide, pulling it tight. Draw your elbows down to your sides, then reach back up.

exercises.name: Towel pull-down
exercises.cue: Stand tall, a towel overhead pulled tight. Draw your elbows down to your sides, keep the pull, then reach back up.

exercises.name: Straight-arm towel pull-down
exercises.cue: Lean forward a little, towel pulled tight, arms long. Sweep it down to your thighs, elbows straight, then back up.

exercises.name: Standing band pull-down
exercises.cue: Band over the top of a door. Stand tall and pull your elbows down to your sides.

exercises.name: Straight-arm band pull-down
exercises.cue: Band anchored high in front. Arms long, sweep your hands down to your thighs, then let them rise slowly.

exercises.name: Straight-arm cable pull-down
exercises.cue: Pulley set high. Arms long, sweep the bar down to your thighs, then let it rise slowly.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable pull-down
exercises.cue: Pulley above you. Pull your elbow down to your side, then let your arm rise all the way.

exercises.name: Slow lowering chin-up
exercises.cue: Step up so your chin is by the bar. Lower yourself as slowly as you can, then step back up.

exercises.name: Seated straight-leg lift
exercises.cue: Sit tall, one leg out straight with the heel down. Lift it a little, pause, and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Step taps
exercises.cue: Stand tall in front of a low step. Tap one foot on top, bring it back, then the other.

exercises.name: Supported back step
exercises.cue: Hand on the counter. Step one foot back, bend both knees a little, then step in again.

exercises.name: Split squat
exercises.cue: One foot forward, hands on your hips. Lower your back knee towards the floor, then push back up.

exercises.name: Backpack step-up
exercises.cue: Backpack on. Whole foot on the step, push through it to stand up, then step down slowly.

exercises.name: Chair Bulgarian split squat
exercises.cue: Back foot on a chair behind you. Lower until your front thigh is nearly level, then stand.

exercises.name: Backpack reverse lunge
exercises.cue: Backpack on. Step back and lower your back knee towards the floor, then push through your front foot to return.

exercises.name: Barbell reverse lunge
exercises.cue: Bar across your upper back. Step back into a lunge, then drive through your front foot to stand.

exercises.name: Seated backpack hug
exercises.cue: Sit tall, hugging a loaded bag to your chest. Shoulders down, breathe and hold.

exercises.name: Backpack walk
exercises.cue: A loaded backpack on both shoulders. Walk tall, slow and steady.

exercises.name: One-bag carry
exercises.cue: One loaded bag in one hand. Walk tall and don't let it pull you sideways.

exercises.name: Waiter carry
exercises.cue: A full bottle held straight up overhead. Ribs down, walk slowly.

exercises.name: Backpack front carry
exercises.cue: Hug a loaded bag to your chest, elbows in. Walk tall and breathe.

exercises.name: Backpack and bags walk
exercises.cue: Backpack on and a bag in each hand. Tall posture, small steady steps.

exercises.name: Marching bag hold
exercises.cue: A loaded bag in each hand. March slowly on the spot, knees up, staying tall.

exercises.name: Kettlebell waiter carry
exercises.cue: Bell held straight up overhead, wrist strong. Ribs down, walk slowly.

exercises.name: Mixed carry
exercises.cue: One bell at your chest, one by your side. Stay level and walk slowly.

exercises.name: Seated dead bug
exercises.cue: Sit tall, leaning back a touch, arms forward. Reach one arm up as the opposite leg straightens, then swap.

exercises.name: Forearm wall plank
exercises.cue: Forearms on the wall, step your feet back, body in one line. Breathe and hold.

exercises.name: Standing marching dead bug
exercises.cue: Stand tall, arms forward, tummy braced. Lift one knee as the opposite arm reaches up, then lower and swap.

exercises.name: Counter bird dog
exercises.cue: One hand on the counter, hinge forward a little. Reach the other arm forward and the opposite leg back, then return.

exercises.name: Wall plank march
exercises.cue: Hands on the wall, body in one line. Lift one knee towards the wall, lower, then the other.

exercises.name: Slow counter climber
exercises.cue: Hands on the counter, body in one line. Slowly bring one knee in, step it back, then the other.

exercises.name: Chair plank
exercises.cue: Chair against a wall, hands on the seat, body in one line. Breathe and hold.

exercises.name: Counter plank with reach
exercises.cue: Hands on the counter, body in one line. Reach one arm forward without letting your hips turn, then swap.

exercises.name: Chair plank knee drive
exercises.cue: Hands on the chair seat, body in one line. Slowly bring one knee in, step it back, then the other.

exercises.name: Chair plank with reach
exercises.cue: Hands on the chair seat, body in one line. Reach one arm forward, hips still, then swap.

exercises.name: Seated bottle halo
exercises.cue: Sit tall, a bottle in both hands. Circle it slowly round your head, then go the other way.

exercises.name: Bottle halo
exercises.cue: Stand tall, ribs down, a bottle in both hands. Circle it slowly round your head without leaning.

exercises.name: Suitcase hold
exercises.cue: A loaded bag in one hand. Stand tall without leaning towards it. Breathe and hold.

exercises.name: Suitcase march
exercises.cue: A loaded bag in one hand. March slowly on the spot, staying level.

exercises.name: Backpack halo
exercises.cue: Hold the bag by its sides. Circle it slowly round your head, ribs down, then go the other way.

exercises.name: Backpack wood chop
exercises.cue: Hold the bag up by one shoulder. Bring it down across your body towards the other knee, turning through your middle, then lift it back.

exercises.name: Counter side plank
exercises.cue: Side on, forearm on the counter, feet stacked. Lift your hips into a straight line and hold.

exercises.name: Chair side plank
exercises.cue: Chair against a wall, forearm on the seat, feet stacked. Lift your hips into a straight line and hold.

exercises.name: Backpack lift
exercises.cue: Squat with the bag by one hip. Stand and lift it up across your body, over the other shoulder, then lower back down.

exercises.name: Standing band chop
exercises.cue: Band anchored high behind you. Pull it down across your body, turning through your middle, hips facing forward.

exercises.name: Seated heel-toe rock
exercises.cue: Sit tall, feet flat. Lift your toes, then roll forward and lift your heels. Keep it slow.

exercises.name: Supported rock forward and back
exercises.cue: Fingertips on the counter. Rock onto your toes, then back onto your heels, slow and small.

exercises.name: Supported march
exercises.cue: Fingertips on the counter. March slowly on the spot, lifting each knee a little.

exercises.name: Heel-to-toe walk, with support
exercises.cue: A hand along the counter. Heel touches toe with every step, eyes ahead.

exercises.name: Single-leg reach, with support
exercises.cue: Standing on one leg, a hand on the counter. Reach the other arm forward slowly, then back.

exercises.name: Single-leg toe taps, with support
exercises.cue: Standing on one leg, a hand on the counter. Tap the other toe forward, then back, without putting weight on it.

exercises.name: Standing toe raise
exercises.cue: Fingertips on the counter. Lift the fronts of your feet, heels down, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Bent-knee heel raise
exercises.cue: Fingertips on the counter, knees softly bent. Rise onto the balls of your feet, keep the bend, then lower.

exercises.name: Heel raise holding bags
exercises.cue: A bag in each hand, standing tall. Rise onto the balls of your feet, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Bent-knee single-leg heel raise
exercises.cue: One foot hooked behind, standing knee softly bent. Rise up, keep the bend, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Single-leg heel raise on a step
exercises.cue: Ball of one foot on the step edge, a hand on the wall. Lower the heel slowly below the step, then rise.

exercises.name: Weighted single-leg heel raise on a step
exercises.cue: Weight in your free hand, a hand on the wall. Lower the heel below the step, then rise all the way.
